title: Marketplace listing screenshots + asset checklist (AWS & GCP) — Listing refresh
content:
Purpose
- Single checklist for all visual assets required for AWS + GCP Marketplace listing refresh.
- Includes owners, due dates, review status, and where the asset is used.
- NOTE: Keep copy in images consistent with approved messaging (see Confluence positioning guidelines). Avoid absolute claims ("fastest", "cheapest"); use "optimized for latency/cost".

Marketplace constraints (quick reference)
- Source of truth exports: PNG preferred; SVG only for diagrams if accepted by portal, otherwise export to PNG.
- Avoid tiny text; assume scaled-down viewing in Marketplace cards.
- Console screenshots must use demo org "Redwood Demo" and anonymized IDs. No customer names.
- If we show model names, use publicly listed models only (no partner-private model identifiers).
- Security images must not imply certifications beyond what’s approved; use "SOC 2 Type II" wording only where reviewed by Security/GRC.

Status legend
- Not started: no capture or draft yet
- Draft ready: captured/created, needs review
- In review: reviewers assigned, feedback pending
- Approved: final asset ready to upload
- Uploaded: placed in AWS/GCP portal + version tracked

Checklist table
Columns: ID | Asset | Type | Placement (AWS/GCP) | Owner | Due | Reviewers | Status | Notes / capture guidance | File naming

1 | Hero image: "Redwood Inference Platform" (product + environment flexibility) | Graphic (PNG) | AWS + GCP listing hero | Alicia Perez | 2026-01-22 | Camila Reyes; Soojin Lee | Approved | Must visually differentiate Hosted / Dedicated / Private in one frame; no pricing text | hero-redwood-inference-platform-v1.png

2 | Logo pack: Redwood logo (light/dark) + icon | Brand (PNG/SVG) | AWS + GCP (logo upload + docs) | Alicia Perez | 2026-01-17 | Camila Reyes | Uploaded | Use latest brand kit; ensure safe margins; provide square + horizontal | redwood-logo-horizontal-dark.png; redwood-logo-horizontal-light.png; redwood-icon-square.png

3 | Screenshot: Console onboarding entrypoint (Marketplace path) | Screenshot (PNG) | AWS + GCP gallery | Chloe Martin | 2026-01-24 | Tessa Morgan; Alex Martinez | Uploaded | Show the first screen after "Continue from Marketplace"; show entitlement check step (no errors) | console-marketplace-onboarding-entrypoint-v2.png

4 | Screenshot: Entitlement validated + org provisioning success | Screenshot (PNG) | AWS + GCP gallery | Chloe Martin | 2026-01-24 | Tessa Morgan; Chris Osei | Uploaded | Include callout text overlays optional (keep minimal); show "Org linked" state | console-marketplace-entitlement-success-org-linked-v1.png

5 | Screenshot: Error state (entitlement propagation delay) + retry guidance | Screenshot (PNG) | AWS + GCP FAQ/support section (optional) | Chloe Martin | 2026-01-26 | Tessa Morgan; Dev Patel | Draft ready | Needs to be helpful but not scary; show "Try again" + "Contact support" CTA; no internal error IDs | console-marketplace-entitlement-delay-retry-v1.png

6 | Screenshot: Create API key (first key flow) | Screenshot (PNG) | AWS + GCP gallery | Chloe Martin | 2026-01-26 | Alex Martinez; Elliot Price | Approved | Must show key created confirmation (blur key value) | console-api-key-create-success-v1.png

7 | Screenshot: Hosted API usage dashboard (tokens/cost/latency) | Screenshot (PNG) | AWS + GCP gallery | Ben Carter | 2026-01-29 | Camila Reyes; Soojin Lee | In review | Should highlight token-level breakdown panel; ensure data looks realistic but not huge $$ | console-usage-dashboard-cost-latency-v2.png

8 | Screenshot: Model catalog (Redwood-verified performance profiles) | Screenshot (PNG) | AWS + GCP gallery | Wei Chen | 2026-01-29 | Soojin Lee; Alex Martinez | Approved | Show model selection + "Verified"/"Profile" elements; no unreleased models | console-model-catalog-verified-profiles-v1.png

9 | Screenshot: Observability trace / request drill-down | Screenshot (PNG) | AWS + GCP gallery | Ben Carter | 2026-01-31 | Elliot Price; Marcus Lin | Draft ready | Must not include raw prompts with sensitive content; use lorem prompt | console-trace-request-drilldown-v1.png

10 | Screenshot: Rollouts (canary + fallback policy) | Screenshot (PNG) | AWS + GCP gallery | Kira Thompson | 2026-02-02 | Soojin Lee; Priya Natarajan | In review | Show a canary rollout and automatic fallback toggle; avoid SLA numbers unless approved | console-rollouts-canary-fallback-policy-v1.png

11 | Diagram: "How it works" (Subscription → Entitlement → Org provisioning → First API call → Metering) | Diagram (PNG) | AWS + GCP listing long description + docs | Simran Kaur | 2026-01-27 | Alex Martinez; Chris Osei; Ethan Park | Approved | Must match design spec for flow; keep provider-specific badges optional | diagram-marketplace-subscription-to-first-token-v3.png

12 | Diagram: Deployment modes comparison (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) | Diagram (PNG) | AWS + GCP gallery + one section in description | Simran Kaur | 2026-01-28 | Soojin Lee; Camila Reyes | Approved | Show core differences: isolation, throughput predictability, networking; avoid "on-prem everywhere" claim | diagram-deployment-modes-hosted-dedicated-private-v2.png

13 | Diagram: High-level data flow (request path + where data lives) | Diagram (PNG) | Security packet + listing security section | Marcus Lin | 2026-02-03 | Dr. Aisha Rahman; Naomi Feldman; Olga Petrov | In review | Include: API/SDK → edge → control plane → inference runtime; note logs/metrics; show private deployment boundaries | diagram-security-data-flow-high-level-v2.png

14 | Diagram: Shared responsibility model (Redwood vs Customer) | Diagram (PNG) | Security packet (marketplace review) | Naomi Feldman | 2026-02-03 | Dr. Aisha Rahman; Sofia Mendes | Draft ready | Must be conservative; align with marketplace security questionnaire responses | diagram-shared-responsibility-marketplace-v1.png

15 | Diagram: Encryption & key management (at rest/in transit; KMS options) | Diagram (PNG) | Security packet | Marcus Lin | 2026-02-05 | Dr. Aisha Rahman; Olga Petrov | Draft ready | Do not specify cipher suites; ok to state TLS in transit + encryption at rest; include KMS integration points | diagram-encryption-and-kms-v1.png

16 | Screenshot: Audit log viewer (event types + export) | Screenshot (PNG) | Security packet + listing security section (optional) | Naomi Feldman | 2026-02-06 | Olga Petrov; Elliot Price | Not started | Use sample org; show events like API key created, role changed, model version pinned; include export option | console-audit-logs-view-export-v1.png

17 | Screenshot: Dedicated capacity configuration (GPU pool / autoscaling policy) | Screenshot (PNG) | AWS + GCP gallery (Dedicated section) | Lauren Bishop | 2026-02-06 | Priya Natarajan; Soojin Lee | In review | Show capacity reservation + autoscaling settings; ensure no cloud account IDs visible | console-dedicated-capacity-autoscaling-v1.png

18 | Screenshot: Private deployment networking option (VPC/private endpoint settings) | Screenshot (PNG) | AWS + GCP gallery (Private section) | Colin O'Donnell | 2026-02-07 | Marcus Lin; Vivek Kulkarni | Not started | If UI not available, use architecture diagram instead; avoid implying one-click on-prem if not true | console-private-networking-settings-v1.png

19 | Icon set: Feature bullets icons (latency, cost controls, reliability, security) | Icons (SVG/PNG) | AWS + GCP listing feature bullets | Alicia Perez | 2026-01-25 | Camila Reyes | Approved | Simple line icons; consistent stroke; export PNG for portals that don’t like SVG | icons-marketplace-feature-bullets-v1.zip

20 | Customer support/contact graphic (support tiers + where to route) | Graphic (PNG) | AWS + GCP listing support section | Dev Patel | 2026-02-04 | Jasmine Liu; Camila Reyes | Draft ready | Show support entrypoints (Docs, Support portal, SE) and response-time language only if approved | graphic-marketplace-support-routing-v1.png

21 | Screenshot: Docs site marketplace onboarding landing page | Screenshot (PNG) | AWS + GCP listing "Documentation" section | Elliot Price | 2026-02-08 | Alex Martinez; Chris Osei | In review | Must use final URLs planned for submission; capture with nav visible | docs-marketplace-onboarding-landing-v1.png

22 | Screenshot: Marketplace security overview page (public) | Screenshot (PNG) | AWS + GCP listing security section + partner review | Elliot Price | 2026-02-08 | Dr. Aisha Rahman; Olga Petrov | Not started | Ensure headings match the published security overview; no internal evidence links in screenshot | docs-marketplace-security-overview-v1.png

23 | "Metering & billing" schematic (dimensions → Redwood meters) | Diagram (PNG) | Internal only (enablement), optional for listing | Cole Summers | 2026-02-09 | Emily Stone; Laura Bennett; Chris Osei | Not started | For internal clarity; only publish if Finance/Legal approves; avoid showing discount terms | diagram-marketplace-metering-mapping-internal-v1.png

Open questions / blockers
- Need confirmation from Partnerships whether AWS listing gallery prefers 5–7 images max; if yes, we should pick a subset (IDs 1, 3, 6, 7, 11, 12, 13) and keep the rest for docs.
- Confirm final docs URLs for screenshots (INT-771 redirects) before capturing IDs 21–22.
- Private networking UI screenshot (ID 18): may be better as an architecture diagram depending on product readiness; Colin to confirm by 2026-02-04.

Review & approval process
- First-pass review: PMM (Soojin) + Marketing (Camila) for messaging alignment.
- UX quality review: Tessa for legibility and layout.
- Security artifacts: Naomi + Marcus + Aisha + Olga; final wording sign-off via Security/GRC.
- Upload owner (portal): Stephanie Nguyen (AWS) and Lukas Meyer (GCP) once assets are approved; Alicia to hand off the final zip + manifest.

Export + delivery notes
- Store final assets in shared drive folder: shared_drives/go-to-market/marketplace-refresh/assets/final/ (Alicia to create folder + set permissions).
- Provide a single "upload-manifest.txt" listing each filename, placement, and last approval date.
- When a screenshot depends on a specific build (console onboarding screens), record the release tag/commit in notes.

Changelog
- 2026-01-13: Created checklist from DES-913 scope.
- 2026-01-24: Marked onboarding screenshots as uploaded after console flow stabilized.
- 2026-02-10: Updated security diagram statuses and added docs landing page screenshot requirements.
